mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + c.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code c ON t.class_key = c.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND c.class_type IN (1, 2) AND t.yy = '2025' AND t.mm = '10' AND t.user_code = 'DAE001cos' FOR XML PATH ('') ), 1, 1, '') AS subject FROM erp_student s WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND t.yy = '2025' AND t.mm = '10' AND t.user_code = 'DAE001cos')
